title: App details
description: One row per delivered app, plus free status rows that explain what was not delivered.

dataset.title: Apps
dataset.description: Every delivered app carries actorInput, actorIndex, platform, appId, storeId, title, developer, rating, ratingsCount, reviewsCount, installs, installsExact, price, currency, free, genres, version, released, lastUpdated, contentRating, adSupported, offersInAppPurchases, minimumOs, fileSizeBytes, languages, country, iconUrl, storeUrl, status and billable. Rows with a status other than OK carry reason instead of data: no appId, no title, no icon and no storeUrl.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: Counters: appsRequested, appsAttempted, appsRead, appsNotFound, appsInvalid, appsDuplicate, appsFailed, appsLimited, appsCutByBudget, appsCutByStop, appsCutByDeadline, appsDelivered, appsCapped, rowsWritten, byStatus, chargedEvents, deliveredUncharged, deliveredUnverified, chargeUncertain, writeErrors, summaryWriteErrors, billingActive, priceEvent, priceNote, country, lang, platform, includeDescription, maxApps, counterMismatch, stopReason, datasetNote, startedAt, finishedAt. Status codes: OK, INVALID_INPUT, DUPLICATE, NOT_FOUND, NOT_CHECKED_LIMIT, NOT_CHECKED_TIME, NOT_CHECKED_ERROR, NOT_CHECKED_CAP, NOT_CHECKED_BILLING. Stop reasons: dataset-write-error, billing-price-unknown, spending-cap, charge-error, deadline.
